نتحارب (form VI)
# نَتَحَارَبُ (nataḥārabu) /na.ta.ħaː.ra.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# نَتَحَارَبَ (nataḥāraba) /na.ta.ħaː.ra.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
# نَتَحَارَبْ (nataḥārab) /na.ta.ħaː.rab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَحَارَبَ (taḥāraba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
